1.  Introduction

   This document specifies the Brotli compressed data format.

1.1.  Purpose

   The goal of this specification is to define a lossless compressed
   data format that can be decoded reliably across conforming
Alakuijala & Szabadka          Informational                    [Page 3]
RFC 7932                Brotli Compressed Data Format          July 2016
   implementations regardless of platform architecture.

1.2.  Compliance

   A compliant decoder must reject malformed streams.
